scope: Six fixed artifact URL/name/size/SHA identities and their exact external source origins.
Checksum payload hash-before-parse and exact basename/hash set comparison.
Normal UV named Registry requirement bootstrap into the explicit external venv.
Original frozen/offline sync check, original uv run Ruff version check, and second frozen/offline check.
Retention of qualification=false and no actual maintenance/test dispatch by this preparation driver.

observations.finding: The entire original dependency plan is byte/SHA256/Git-blob pinned before its six artifact roles are read. All fixed project source pins are checked against the admitted source.

Each download uses the pinned HTTPS URL and bounded bytes, checks actual status, optional Content-Length, total size and full SHA256, then reads the downloaded file back. Redirects preserve the actual request while logging only query-free destinations and retaining default TLS/proxy settings.

UV checksum payload and V8 checksum payload are themselves exact-hash downloaded. The parser requires lowercase 64-hex digests, canonical basenames, no duplicate entries and exact expected set equality: one UV archive and the original two V8 sandbox artifacts.
Only the unique regular UV ELF is extracted from the verified bounded archive. The real executable reports exactly version 0.11.3 before bootstrap.
The actual pinned Ruff wheel is opened for metadata inspection. Name ruff, version 0.15.13 and no Requires-Dist are required; original METADATA bytes are retained.

The source-reviewed named requirement is preserved exactly. The sequence is uv venv with explicit /usr/bin/python3; uv pip install --offline --no-index --find-links wheelhouse --python external-venv/bin/python ruff==0.15.13; original uv sync --frozen --project scripts --offline --check; original uv run --frozen --project scripts ruff --version; and another original frozen/offline check.

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT, UV_CACHE_DIR, RUFF_CACHE_DIR and UV_OFFLINE=true are explicit external values. UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never is set. No bare-Ruff maintenance substitution, --no-sync or direct-wheel requirement is introduced.

Each actual preparation command must have returncode 0, no timeout and no output limit. Final file identities and exact source/input comparisons are separately required. Any readiness remains preparation status only; qualification stays false.

limitations: This is a static peer review of the assigned download/bootstrap scope, not a full security audit or a native runtime result.
Actual checksum text payloads and binary artifacts have not been downloaded or executed by this reviewer. Their exact published payload hashes are used to constrain the native operation.

Normal installed Registry satisfaction validates installed kind/version; the driver owns the independent artifact hash and isolated-bootstrap evidence. A sync --check result must not be described as re-hashing all installed executable bytes.
Actual current interpreter/platform/depot/free-space and command outcomes remain subject to the real driver checks.
The source remains PREPARATION/HOLD; all existing qualification failures and unrun gates are unaffected.
